summary: Marvell Technology, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a commercial agreement with Google LLC for custom semiconductor products (AI accelerators, storage, networking) and the issuance of a warrant to purchase up to 58,970,907 shares at $206.58 per share. The warrant vests in quarterly installments (time-based) and in 240 tranches tied to $500 million revenue milestones through fiscal 2033. The filing covers a material contract and unregistered securities sale, not a special-situation event. No deal terms such as premium or close date apply. Routine disclosure, not a special situation.
